\begin{abstract}
We propose a new defense against model inversion attacks.

\section{Introduction}
Model inversion reconstructs training inputs from model outputs.
Prior defenses reduce utility substantially on face recognition benchmarks.

\section{Results}
Our defense keeps accuracy high while lowering reconstruction quality.
